_source: Forge-C factory/checklists/v0.4/SWE.3.yaml and the inherited v0.3 factory/release-manager/checklists/SWE.3.yaml, neutralised for feature 023

items.title: Consistent with architecture
items.pass_criterion: Detailed design, unit-level APIs and interfaces match the software architecture (names, signatures, allocated behaviour).
items.typical_defect: Unit API signature differs from the interface defined in the architecture.

items.title: Unit specification and trace
items.pass_criterion: Every unit has a detailed design (static and dynamic) in a notation that parses and a unit specification; every unit-spec item traces to a requirement allocated to the unit's element, and every allocated requirement is refined.
items.typical_defect: Allocated requirement not refined by any unit-spec item; design view fails to parse.

items.title: Code-to-design trace
items.pass_criterion: Every function carries trace annotations naming its unit and unit-spec items, the documentation generator runs without warnings, and every unit-spec item is referenced by code.
items.typical_defect: Function with no trace annotation; unit-spec item referenced by no code.

items.title: Implementation complete
items.pass_criterion: Every function allocated in the architecture is declared in the public interface and defined in the source; functions called across layers are defined; no code is commented out.
items.typical_defect: Allocated API declared but never defined, or implementation left inside a comment.

items.title: Hardware definitions conform to reference
items.pass_criterion: Every hardware definition (register offset, bit position, mask) matches the controlled hardware reference supplied as input; no definition exists for a register or field absent from that reference.
items.typical_defect: Invented register offset or mask not present in the hardware reference.

items.title: Safe hardware and data access
items.pass_criterion: Code handles hardware access, volatile qualification, bounds, initialisation and read-modify-write safely.
items.typical_defect: Unbounded array index, or non-atomic read-modify-write on a shared register.

items.title: Bounded concurrency, timing and error propagation
items.pass_criterion: Interrupt/concurrency behaviour, waits and loops are bounded (e.g. by timeout), and error propagation to callers is defined and consistent.
items.typical_defect: Polling loop on a hardware flag with no timeout; error code silently dropped.

items.title: Coding guideline conformance
items.pass_criterion: Code conforms to the project's coding guideline and language subset; static-analysis findings and guideline deviations are recorded with rationale.
items.typical_defect: Guideline violations with no recorded deviation; static-analysis report missing.

items.title: Resource usage bounded
items.pass_criterion: No dynamic memory where prohibited; stack, code and data memory impacts are measured or budgeted against the architecture budgets.
items.typical_defect: Heap allocation in a context where it is prohibited; no stack estimate.

items.title: Source matches design with provenance
items.pass_criterion: Units and source match the detailed design, with change and trace provenance (version identity of design and code).
items.typical_defect: Code changed after design baseline with no corresponding design update or change record.
